## Requirements (ticket contract)

1. **Persisted concurrence record** — an append-only
   officer-naming decision record (subject, predicate/row, the five
   prongs' evaluations, two independent reviewers' written positions,
   reasoning, `date -u` stamps) the export/web path reads; absent or
   non-concur → withhold. Additive record kind on the existing
   review/decision mechanism, never an edit of a landed one.
2. **Publication-path routing** — every `isPublicEmployeeName` row
   passes through the gate: the persisted decision's
   `evaluate_officer_naming` semantics + `publication_permitted`
   jurisdiction rule; BOTH must permit. Missing record, failed prong,
   non-concur or unknown jurisdiction → withhold. The web gate only
   ever withholds.
3. **Ingest-path coherence** — the OKC ingest evaluation writes the
   persisted record (the same decision object the publication gate
   reads; one decision, not two evaluations).
4. **Fixture + test corrections** — `web_dossier.py`'s `Approving
   official` row carries a persisted concurrence reference to stay
   shown or renders withheld; `publication.test.ts:17` and siblings
   assert the concurrence precondition on top of the jurisdiction
   matrix (fixed, not loosened); `test_policy_officer.py` stays green
   or gains the persistence-side cases.
5. **Carve-outs stand** — `is_home_address` / `is_routine_audit_row`
   refusals preserved verbatim through the persisted record
   (SIG-PUB-009/010).
6. **Requirement stamps** in the PR body: SIG-PUB-007 (+ cited
   SIG-PUB-008/009/010/017).

## Acceptance criteria (ticket §Acceptance criteria)

- engineered: the persisted concurrence record exists, append-only;
  the publication gate reads it (no record → withhold); the ingest
  evaluation writes the same record; `make check` +
  `npm --prefix web run check` green.
- fixture-verified: concur record + permissive jurisdiction → shown;
  missing record / single reviewer / dissent → withheld; unknown
  jurisdiction → withheld; home-address + audit-row carve-outs
  withhold regardless of record.
- staging-verified: the dossier builder withholds an unrecorded name
  row over fixture input; no page renders a name whose record is
  absent.
- live-executed: n/a — committed code only; effect lands with the next
  export/web build (recorded).
- public: at next build — a name without a concurrence record never
  reaches a built page (asserted over the gate + fixtures; the live
  build output assertion lands with the next export/web build —
  recorded).
- human-completed: the two-reviewer concurrence stays a human act —
  this row claims no decision and signs none (recorded).
- verification green: `make check`; every new behaviour has a failing-
  if-removed test; tests assert invariants never living records;
  requirement ids stamped; DEFERRALS row for anything not
  automatically verifiable; ADR for owned decisions.
- `ci:` head-bound after push (ci_boundary; 5 checks); red/pending →
  blockedOn, no close on red.
- closeout one commit after the PR exists: this run ledger,
  `pr/P35.28.md`, BUILD_INDEX row 286, LEDGER advance, README
  row-range pin, projection regen, post-closeout second boundary read.
- record rules: protected records append-only; `memory_guard.py all
  --staged` green before closeout.

| e2e | `jurisdiction.spec.ts`: US dossier shows `withheld`, body never contains the name; FR/BE legs unchanged |
